title: The Polite Collapse
subtitle: The service accepts every request until none finish

brief.narrative: Arrival rate exceeds capacity. Queues grow without bounds, latency exceeds client timeouts, retries multiply load, and useful throughput approaches zero.
symptoms: Public API metrics diverge from the service-level symptom
The problem reproduces only under the triggering workload
Logs contain enough evidence to distinguish cause from consequence
brief.objective: Identify the root cause, select a production-safe fix, and explain the trade-off.

rootCause.question: Which root cause explains all of the evidence?

options.text: A single hot key concentrated traffic on one partition.
options.feedback: This choice does not explain the complete evidence or leaves the underlying correctness/reliability problem intact.

options.text: Untrusted input was interpreted as SQL code.
options.feedback: This choice does not explain the complete evidence or leaves the underlying correctness/reliability problem intact.

options.text: Unbounded queueing and retries turned overload into congestion collapse.
options.feedback: Correct. Availability is the fraction of useful responses within a deadline. Rejecting excess work early can preserve more successful work overall.

options.text: Processing exceeded the poll interval and triggered repeated consumer-group rebalances.
options.feedback: This choice does not explain the complete evidence or leaves the underlying correctness/reliability problem intact.

fix.question: Which fix is safest for production?

options.text: Use parameterized queries for values, allowlist dynamic identifiers/operators, minimize DB privileges, and test authorization independently.
options.feedback: This choice does not explain the complete evidence or leaves the underlying correctness/reliability problem intact.

options.text: Set admission limits, bounded queues and deadlines; shed low-priority work, apply retry budgets/backoff, degrade gracefully, and scale from saturation signals.
options.feedback: Correct. Availability is the fraction of useful responses within a deadline. Rejecting excess work early can preserve more successful work overall.

options.text: Reduce/bound processing, tune poll records and interval from measured worst cases, use cooperative rebalancing, and isolate poison or slow records.
options.feedback: This choice does not explain the complete evidence or leaves the underlying correctness/reliability problem intact.

options.text: Use near-cache/request coalescing, replicate or split the hot value when safe, protect origin with limits, and track per-key/per-shard load.
